name: Vascular physical and boundary models
name_zh: 血流动力学与血管边界模型
summary: Lumped and distributed hemodynamic models and physically interpretable boundary conditions.
summary_zh: 包括血管阻抗、Windkessel、结构树边界等生理物理建模方法。
scope_note: Current seed focuses on boundary models, not all 0D/1D/3D models.
scope_note_zh: 当前主要覆盖出口边界模型，完整的0D/1D/3D血流模型有待扩展。
